description.value: The Barley Merchant is a craft-focused taproom and kitchen in Langley, BC, built around a strict 'We Serve BC' philosophy: all 50 taps pour exclusively from independently owned BC breweries, cideries, and distilleries. Since opening, it has rotated through more than 2,100 unique BC craft beers from over 165 breweries across the province. A full food menu sourced from BC ingredients accompanies the drinks program in a relaxed, upbeat setting.
